name: tasktree
description: Project management with infinitely nested tasks, Kanban and list views, comments, and test case tracking.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
